Test Case Description: Verify Group Details screen loads successfully
Preconditions: User is logged in and has access to Group Maintenance Data Entry modules
Test Steps: 1. Open Group Maintenance | 2. Click Data Entry > Group Details | 3. Wait for load completion
Expected Result: Group Details screen loads with no blocking error and core sections are visible

Test Case Description: Verify module ID hidden value is rendered
Preconditions: Screen is opened from parent module with module context
Test Steps: 1. Inspect hidden field moduleId_group_details
Expected Result: Hidden field exists and contains module context value

Test Case Description: Verify header controls are visible
Preconditions: Group Details screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Observe title bar and right side controls
Expected Result: Refresh and Close buttons are visible with proper icons and tooltips

Test Case Description: Verify Group Information section default state
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Check Group Information section on initial load
Expected Result: Section is expanded by default and Sub Group controls are visible

Test Case Description: Verify Behind the Scene section default state
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Check Behind the Scene section on initial load
Expected Result: Section is expanded by default and audit summary fields are visible

Test Case Description: Verify section collapse and expand interactions
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Collapse Group Information | 2. Expand Group Information | 3. Collapse Behind the Scene | 4. Expand Behind the Scene
Expected Result: Each section toggles correctly and chevron icon state updates

Test Case Description: Verify Sub Group lookup opens search modal
Preconditions: Screen is in mode that allows subgroup selection
Test Steps: 1. Click Sub Group lookup icon
Expected Result: Search modal opens for Sub Group lookup

Test Case Description: Verify Sub Group selection populates ID and description
Preconditions: Search modal is open with selectable records
Test Steps: 1. Search valid subgroup | 2. Select a record
Expected Result: Sub Group ID and Group Description fields populate with selected values

Test Case Description: Verify View action loads existing subgroup details
Preconditions: Valid subgroup is selected
Test Steps: 1. Click View | 2. Wait for load
Expected Result: Existing subgroup details and audit summary values are retrieved and displayed

Test Case Description: Verify Add action enables data entry flow
Preconditions: Screen is loaded in view/default mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Observe control and button state changes
Expected Result: Screen enters add mode with editable controls and Save/Cancel enabled per business flow

Test Case Description: Verify Edit action requires loaded record
Preconditions: No existing subgroup record is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit
Expected Result: System blocks edit and prompts user to load/view a valid record first

Test Case Description: Verify Delete action requires loaded record
Preconditions: No existing subgroup record is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click Delete
Expected Result: System blocks delete and shows validation prompt

Test Case Description: Verify Save action enforces required subgroup fields
Preconditions: Add mode is active
Test Steps: 1. Leave Sub Group ID and/or description empty | 2. Click Save
Expected Result: System prevents save and displays required field validation

Test Case Description: Create new Group Details record with valid data
Preconditions: Add mode is active and user has create permission
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid subgroup values | 2. Click Save
Expected Result: Record is created successfully and success feedback is shown

Test Case Description: Verify duplicate Sub Group ID is rejected
Preconditions: An existing subgroup record already exists
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Enter duplicate Sub Group ID | 3. Click Save
Expected Result: System rejects duplicate subgroup as per business uniqueness rule

Test Case Description: Edit existing Group Details record
Preconditions: Existing record loaded in view mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit | 2. Update editable values | 3. Click Save
Expected Result: Record is updated successfully and latest values display on view

Test Case Description: Cancel in Add mode discards unsaved changes
Preconditions: Add mode active with unsaved input
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Enter test values | 3. Click Cancel
Expected Result: Unsaved values are discarded and screen returns to safe default/view state

Test Case Description: Cancel in Edit mode restores original values
Preconditions: Existing record loaded and modified in Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit | 2. Modify values | 3. Click Cancel
Expected Result: Original persisted values are restored and edit mode exits

Test Case Description: Delete existing Group Details record with confirmation
Preconditions: Existing record selected and delete permission available
Test Steps: 1. Click Delete | 2. Confirm in dialog
Expected Result: Record is deleted successfully and form state resets

Test Case Description: Verify audit summary fields are read-only
Preconditions: Any record is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Attempt to edit No. Of Members Loan Cycle Required or audit values
Expected Result: Audit summary fields remain non-editable display-only values

Test Case Description: Verify No. Of Members reflects backend state
Preconditions: Loaded record has known member count
Test Steps: 1. View record | 2. Compare displayed No. Of Members with backend/expected value
Expected Result: Displayed member count matches backend response

Test Case Description: Verify Loan Cycle Required value maps correctly
Preconditions: Loaded record has configured loan cycle requirement
Test Steps: 1. View record | 2. Inspect Loan Cycle Required field
Expected Result: Displayed value matches configured business rule output

Test Case Description: Verify refresh button reloads latest server data
Preconditions: Record is loaded and refresh action available
Test Steps: 1. Click Refresh | 2. Observe loading indicator and final data state
Expected Result: Screen reloads latest values from backend and reflects updates

Test Case Description: Verify loading overlay behavior during server operations
Preconditions: Trigger a View or Refresh operation
Test Steps: 1. Execute View or Refresh | 2. Observe loading overlay
Expected Result: Loading overlay appears during request and hides after completion

Test Case Description: Verify close action returns user to parent context
Preconditions: Group Details opened as child screen/iframe
Test Steps: 1. Click Close
Expected Result: Child screen closes without breaking parent Group Maintenance page state

Test Case Description: Verify Save API payload includes expected identifiers
Preconditions: Browser network tab available and save operation executed
Test Steps: 1. Perform Add or Edit Save | 2. Inspect network request payload
Expected Result: Payload includes module context subgroup identifiers and relevant data fields

Test Case Description: Verify unauthorized access handling for Group Details
Preconditions: User lacks Group Details permission
Test Steps: 1. Attempt direct navigation to Group Details URL
Expected Result: System denies access or enforces restricted behavior per authorization policy

Test Case Description: Verify action button state transitions across modes
Preconditions: Screen available with at least one existing record
Test Steps: 1. Observe buttons in default mode | 2. Enter Add mode | 3. Enter Edit mode | 4. Return via Cancel
Expected Result: View Add Edit Delete Save Cancel buttons transition correctly according to business workflow state rules
